dates.prior_version_note: The first-month's-rent security deposit cap predates 2025; 2025, c. 9 (eff. 2025-08-01) extended limits to lessor's agents and added fee-in-lieu authority.
The limit on upfront payments by the lessor applied before; 2025, c. 9 (eff. 2025-08-01) extended it to the lessor's agents. A secondary source says the law has been in effect since the 1970s.
Before 2025-08-01 the section only required brokers finding dwellings for a fee to be licensed; 2025, c. 9 added the rule that only the party who engaged the broker pays the fee.
